outcomes.description: Distinguish source wording, assumptions, reasoning and gaps in the evidence.

manifest.course_name: Demo / History: A source's claim and historical practice

records.title: The Declaration's claim about equality
records.text: The words “all men are created equal” express a claim in the document. Evidence about social practice in 1776 requires further sources.
limitations: The declaration of equality alone cannot establish equal treatment in practice.

records.title: Primary-source excerpt on equality
records.text: We hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal,

records.title: Discussion question
records.text: Use the supplied excerpt from the Declaration of Independence. Identify its purpose and the scope of the claim it supports.

records.title: Part a
records.text: Does the excerpt establish that everyone received equal treatment in practice? Identify the additional evidence you would need.
